value.title: Jalpaiguri
value.summary: Jalpaiguri (জলপাইগুড়ি Jolpāiguṛi), a small city on the Teesta River in North Bengal, is a twin of the larger city Siliguri.
transit_modes: You can travel by cycle-rickshaw or totos or autos or city buses, which you can get everywhere, or you can hire a taxi from taxi stands.
